# ECN-2026-047 - Change notice - Heat Treat hydraulic forging press #2

Revision: Rev B  
Plant: P1, line P1-L4  
Equipment: EQ-P1-L4-HP02

Reason for change
- Background: During routine maintenance and an independent review of bolted joint integrity on Heat Treat hydraulic forging press #2 (EQ-P1-L4-HP02), discrepancies were identified between installed main ram bolt seating and expected preload behavior. Review of service records and physical inspection found evidence of bolt relaxation under cyclic loading for the main ram assembly. The potential for joint loosening presents an elevated risk to machine alignment, die seating, and operator safety. This ECN establishes a controlled update to the specified tightening requirement and associated verification practices to ensure consistent clamp load and reduce risk of unplanned downtime and safety incidents.
- Rationale: Engineering assessment determined that a single, clearly documented torque requirement and an updated verification process will reduce variability in assembly practice and improve long term joint reliability. The adopted torque value and verification actions reflect proven installation technique and are intended to align shop practice with inspection evidence and supplier guidance. This change improves traceability of maintenance actions and supports consistent workmanship across shifts.

Affected items
- Equipment affected: Heat Treat hydraulic forging press #2 (EQ-P1-L4-HP02) located on P1, line P1-L4.
- Functional impact: The change affects procedures and records for main ram bolt installation and verification. It applies to any maintenance, rebuild, or assembly activity affecting the main ram bolted joint.
- Documentation affected: Update required for Standard Work and procedure references that control bolting and torque verification on the press. Cite and reconcile with existing procedure documents: SB-1034, SOP-P1-L4-02, SOP-P1-L4-05. Where those documents reference torque or installation acceptance criteria for the main ram bolt, the value and acceptance steps in this ECN shall take precedence until the referenced documents are formally revised.

Implementation
- New torque requirement: The main ram bolt torque for Heat Treat hydraulic forging press #2 (EQ-P1-L4-HP02) is 970 N·m. This is the required applied torque for initial installation and for any work in the assembly where the bolt is removed and reinstalled.
- Installation method: Apply torque using a calibrated torque wrench or torque controlled device. Use a controlled, staged tightening pattern as defined in SB-1034 and SOP-P1-L4-02. Use lubrication practices that match those specified in the referenced procedures to ensure repeatable joint behavior. If additional tightening steps or torque-angle verification are described in SB-1034, SOP-P1-L4-02, or SOP-P1-L4-05, those steps remain applicable and must be followed in combination with the specified torque value.
- Verification: After installation to the specified torque, perform a verification check using an independent torque instrument or calibrated witness device to confirm retention of applied torque. Record the measured value and the instrument identification in the equipment maintenance record. If measured retention differs from expected practice documented in SB-1034, SOP-P1-L4-02, or SOP-P1-L4-05, perform corrective action per those documents and escalate per local maintenance governance.
- Examples and acceptable practice: Example scenario — a maintenance task that requires removal of the main ram bolt must include documented evidence of torque application to 970 N·m and a verification entry in the maintenance record. Example demonstration activities during training shall include hands-on torque application to the specified value and witness verification to reinforce technique and calibration awareness.
- Calibration and tools: Only use torque tools that are within their calibration cycle and traceable to the tool calibration program referenced in SB-1034. Calibration certificates shall be retained with the tool inventory record and referenced in maintenance entries when used for the main ram bolt.
- Records to keep: For every installation event involving the main ram bolt on EQ-P1-L4-HP02, retain the following in the equipment maintenance file: name of technician performing the work, tool identifier, calibration certificate reference, declared applied torque value, independent verification result, and a short note on bolt condition and lubricant used. These entries will be filed in the maintenance system and referenced during post-maintenance inspections and audits.
- Training: Update local maintenance training to include the new specified torque and verification workflow. Supervisors shall ensure technicians demonstrate competence in applying and verifying the specified torque value on representative assemblies prior to independent work.

Approvals
- Approval requirement: This ECN requires review and formal sign-off by the Plant Mechanical Lead, Maintenance Supervisor for P1-L4 line, and Quality Assurance representative responsible for heat treat line controls. The approval confirms alignment with SB-1034, SOP-P1-L4-02, and SOP-P1-L4-05 and that records and training updates are in place.
- Post-approval actions: Upon approval, revise or annotate SB-1034, SOP-P1-L4-02, and SOP-P1-L4-05 to reflect the change or reference this ECN as the controlling document for the main ram bolt torque until a formal revision of those documents is issued. Communicate the change to shop floor maintenance staff and schedule verification audits to confirm implementation.
- Audit and monitoring: Maintenance supervision will perform follow-up inspections and audits of the retained records for a period following implementation to verify compliance with the specified torque requirement and recordkeeping practice. Any recurring anomalies or evidence of joint relaxation after implementation will trigger a review of installation method, lubrication, and joint condition as per SB-1034 and SOP-P1-L4-05.

Related documents
- SB-1034
- SOP-P1-L4-02
- SOP-P1-L4-05

Distribution
- Notify maintenance planning, operations supervision for P1-L4, quality, and tooling control groups. File this ECN in the document control system and reference in the equipment maintenance file for EQ-P1-L4-HP02.
